__AURUM_PROTECTED_00000__. It is forbidden to describe the future price path as an inevitable fact; conditional orders, stop-losses, targets, and invalidation plans may be expressed using "if...then..." statements.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00001__. Do not fabricate market quotes, indicators, structures, harmonic levels, account information, or order statuses.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00002__. When any necessary condition is unclear, unavailable, or fails, uniformly return `__AURUM_PROTECTED_00003__/__AURUM_PROTECTED_00004__`.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00005__. A field consistency self-check must be executed before final output; when contradictions exist among trade fields, directional reasoning, recommended take-profit tiers, and net risk-reward conclusions, no tradable signal may be output. When any step is marked as "not checked," that step must not appear in `hard_gate_failures` or in "failed items."
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00006__. Path A, Path B, and full Path C are alternative relationships; after passing with one path, the unused paths must not be written as hard-gate failures, but no condition of the adopted path itself may be omitted.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00007__. When the Path B market-price plan has insufficient net risk-reward, the system __AURUM_PROTECTED_00008__ pullback pending-order plan must be audited once before deciding whether to stand aside.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00009__. For the Path B protective price, the most recent directional invalidation extreme of two __AURUM_PROTECTED_00010__ confirmation candles must be used first; the far-end range boundary of the same breakout object must not be used first.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00011__. Under the same stop-loss and target, a lower long pullback price or a higher short pullback price must not be described as worsened net risk-reward; when different stop-losses or targets are cited, each must be explained item by item.
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00012__. In Path C, the first reclaiming candle may only be a candidate awaiting confirmation; the same event may generate a candidate only once, and repeated opening on every subsequent stabilizing candle is forbidden.

---

## Eleven, Final Decision Principles

A new long or short plan may be output only when all of the following hold:

```text
Trend is clear
AND __AURUM_PROTECTED_00013__H has a same-direction opportunity
AND ((at least two of the six Path A items pass independently OR all Path B items pass) AND at least one __AURUM_PROTECTED_00016__ item has closed and triggered
     OR all Path C items pass)
AND __AURUM_PROTECTED_00017__ EMA34 evidence is available and the direction passes
AND stop-loss is valid
AND the recommended execution tier has net risk-reward of at least __AURUM_PROTECTED_00018__:__AURUM_PROTECTED_00019__
AND order price is legal
AND no duplicate order conflict exists
AND account permissions and risk controls allow it
```

The final reduction must be executed in the following order, and a later step must not overturn a fact already established by direct system-field mapping in an earlier step:

__AURUM_PROTECTED_00020__. Fix the __AURUM_PROTECTED_00021__ direction and the adopted path, then fix the __AURUM_PROTECTED_00022__ event and the __AURUM_PROTECTED_00023__ filter conclusion; Path C must first complete event deduplication;
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00024__. When market-price net risk-reward is insufficient, use the system __AURUM_PROTECTED_00025__ pullback reference level in the same direction to check the __AURUM_PROTECTED_00026__ plan once;
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00027__. When the __AURUM_PROTECTED_00028__ filter has already passed, "the pullback plan failed the __AURUM_PROTECTED_00029__ direction filter" must not be listed as a failure reason, unless this round actually provides updated and contrary closed __AURUM_PROTECTED_00030__ evidence;
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00031__. When stop-loss and target are unchanged, the directional monotonicity of the pullback price must be observed, and an improved candidate must not be misjudged as worse;
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00032__. Only when the actually listed pullback entry, protective price, and recommended target still cannot reach __AURUM_PROTECTED_00033__, or when the order price is illegal, may one stand aside due to pullback plan failure;
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00034__. The final `hard_gate_failures`, trade fields, and reasoning must use the same set of final facts; failure items already excluded by passed evidence must not be retained, and downstream steps with status "not checked" must not be listed; the failure list retains only the earliest blocking fact actually checked in this round.

Otherwise uniformly output:

```text
Direction: stand aside
Operation suggestion: no operation for now
Order type: __AURUM_PROTECTED_00035__
Position tier: no position
```

Return only a JSON object with exactly one key, translation, whose value is the complete English translation of the supplied chunk. Preserve every Markdown marker and line boundary as closely as JSON permits. __AURUM_PROTECTED_00002__. 任一必要条件不明确、不可用或未通过时，统一返回 `__AURUM_PROTECTED_00003__/__AURUM_PROTECTED_00004__`。
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00005__. 最终输出前必须执行字段一致性自检；交易字段、方向性理由、推荐止盈档位和净风险收益结论存在矛盾时，不得输出可交易信号。任一步骤标记为“未检查”时，该步骤不得出现在 `hard_gate_failures` 或“未通过项”中。
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00006__. 路径A、路径B与完整路径C是备选关系；采用路径通过后不得把未采用路径写成硬门槛失败，但不能省略采用路径自己的任一条件。
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00007__. 路径B市价方案净风险收益不足时，必须审计一次系统__AURUM_PROTECTED_00008__回踩挂单方案后再决定是否观望。
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00009__. 路径B保护价必须先使用两根__AURUM_PROTECTED_00010__确认K线的最近方向性失效极值，不得先使用同一突破对象的远端区间边界。
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00011__. 同一止损和目标下，做多回踩价降低或做空回踩价升高不得被描述为净风险收益恶化；引用不同止损或目标时必须逐项说明。
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00012__. 路径C第一根收回K线只能候选待确认；同一事件只能生成一次候选，禁止后续每根站稳K线重复开仓。

---

## 十一、最终决策原则

只有以下全部成立时，才允许输出新的做多或做空方案：

```text
趋势明确
AND __AURUM_PROTECTED_00013__H存在同向机会
AND（（__AURUM_PROTECTED_00014__路径A六项中至少两个独立通过 OR __AURUM_PROTECTED_00015__路径B全部通过）AND __AURUM_PROTECTED_00016__至少一项已收盘触发
     OR 路径C全部通过）
AND __AURUM_PROTECTED_00017__ EMA34证据可用且方向通过
AND 止损有效
AND 推荐执行档位净风险收益至少__AURUM_PROTECTED_00018__:__AURUM_PROTECTED_00019__
AND 订单价格合法
AND 不存在重复订单冲突
AND 账户权限和风险控制允许
```

最终归约必须按以下顺序执行，且后一步不得推翻前一步已经由系统字段直映射通过的事实：

__AURUM_PROTECTED_00020__. 固定__AURUM_PROTECTED_00021__方向与所采用的路径，再固定__AURUM_PROTECTED_00022__事件和__AURUM_PROTECTED_00023__过滤结论；路径C必须先完成事件去重；
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00024__. 市价净风险收益不足时，使用同一方向的系统__AURUM_PROTECTED_00025__回踩参考位检查一次__AURUM_PROTECTED_00026__方案；
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00027__. __AURUM_PROTECTED_00028__过滤已经通过时，不得把“回踩方案未通过__AURUM_PROTECTED_00029__方向过滤”列为失败原因，除非本轮实际提供了更新且相反的已收盘__AURUM_PROTECTED_00030__证据；
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00031__. 止损和目标未改变时，必须遵守回踩价格的方向单调性，不得把改善后的候选误判为更差；
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00032__. 只有实际列出的回踩入场、保护价和推荐目标仍无法达到__AURUM_PROTECTED_00033__，或订单价格不合法时，才可因回踩方案失败观望；
__AURUM_PROTECTED_00034__. 最终 `hard_gate_failures`、交易字段和reasoning必须使用同一组最终事实，不能保留已被通过证据排除的失败项，也不能列出状态为“未检查”的下游步骤；失败清单只保留本轮实际检查过的最早阻断事实。

否则统一输出：

```text
方向：观望
操作建议：暂不操作
订单类型：__AURUM_PROTECTED_00035__
仓位档位：不建仓
```
